intro.text: An illegitimate son of Highprince Valam of Jah Keved, said to act as his assassin and executioner.

items.text: Around the turn of 1170, Redin visited the Davar mansion to question Lin Davar about the death of his first wife, as House Davar owed fealty to Valam. Lin pleaded and raged but couldn't shake Redin's smooth calm. When Lin wouldn't cooperate, Redin openly asked witnesses to come forward, within earshot of the Davar children.

In late 1173, at the end of the Veden civil war, Redin stood guard at the deathbed of the newly crowned King Valam, whose only living child he now was. Valam named Taravangian his heir, then asked Redin to stab him through the heart. Redin hesitated, but obeyed and stormed out. The act probably barred him from any claim to the throne.

appearance.text: Tall, with a long, slender face, he purses his lips in a way that makes him look angry or annoyed. One eye is an intense blue and the other dark brown. He wears dark clothes, including a maroon coat with ruffled cuffs.

personality.text: Terse and unflappable when carrying out Valam's orders, he is rumoured to be brutal when necessary. Though Valam treats him with disdain and calls him 'bastard', Redin seems to have a soft spot for his father and seeks his approval.
